main_body: Pink cherry-blossom tree canopy (large rounded leaf mass) on a brown trunk with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Organic canopy: lightest pink clumps at rows ~10-16 near the upper middle sit within the rounded mass; there is no flat horizontal band, the volume is shaded as a rounded dome
evidence: Organic tree. The canopy is a rounded volume with lit upper clumps and a dark underside (rows ~26-31) casting shade onto the trunk. The trunk and grass base sit below it. It reads as a lit-from-above mass with a visible front, comparable to the reference trees, with no flat elevation or rim-only construction. Passes as an organic 3/4 piece.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 pink steps from pale highlight to deep magenta-maroon, and the outline is a dark maroon tinted by the foliage rather than black. Clumps are broad and blocky, with fewer leaf-level dots and less per-leaf detail than the references. The trunk is a flat brown with only 2-3 tones and the grass patch is simple. Large patches of the mid-pink are almost uniform, so it is less rich than the Beodeul trees, which carry many leaf clusters, branch details and roots. Slightly thinner and flatter next to the reference, so it fails on tile density and texture.
